About the game
Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow stars a boy named Griffin as he embarks on a journey to face his fears alongside his teddy bear companion Birly. As Griffin learns to confront haunting memories amidst floating castles and enchanted forests, he’ll come to discover the mystery of this newfound world.

Key Features

 A touching story made for everyone
 Command an adorable teddy bear companion
 Intelligent puzzles
 A charming and mysterious universe
 Unbridled (and sometimes scary!) fantasy fun

notes.title: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow | Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello dreamers!

It's been a while, and we're excited to share our first update. Here's what we've improved:

Better Camera Review
We've made significant improvements to the camera review, resulting in higher quality and clearer visuals. Capturing moments is now more satisfying than ever.

Simplified Challenging Areas
We've streamlined some of the difficult and hard-to-navigate sections, making gameplay smoother. Now, players can progress through these once tough obstacles with ease, ensuring a more enjoyable and seamless journey.

Enhanced AI Characters
We've given Birly and Mira, our lovely characters, notable enhancements. The AI has been refined, bringing more depth and realism to these lovable characters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542110/Daydream_Forgotten_Sorrow

So, brace yourselves, gamers! Get ready to explore a world filled with wonder, danger, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Will you help Griffin and Birly on their quest? The adventure starts now!
